Further reports document that cells expressing the pericyte marker Ng2 + (Cspg4) require Ebf1 for their function and a recent study reported an Rgs5 + subgroup of PDGFR β pericytes with a transcriptomic signature characterized by Ebf1 , as well as Ndufla4l2, Cox4i2 and Higd1b ( Derecka, et al., 2020 ; Duan, et al., 2018 ) all genes we identify as discrete pericyte markers.
